maintenance_led.reason: Mainly consulting, engineering design and project management for water, environment and infrastructure projects, not repair or aftermarket servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Government Services Group serves US federal, state, municipal and development agency clients, including DoD; government is the largest payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth is mainly organic through technical services demand; acquisitions are strategic and occasional rather than a roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Project-based consulting and engineering contracts are rebid regularly; clients can change firms between projects without major disruption.
